title: Useful Netherite Hoes
description: This mod allows you to make a 3x3 of farmland in one click with a netherite hoe!
body:
This mod allows you to make a 3x3 of farmland in one click with a netherite hoe!

Almost no one in the minecrafting world would bother to craft a netherite hoe. The reasons of crafting it is almost always to get the advancement!

However, with this mod, netherite hoes can now make 3x3s of farmland in one click! This means that farming is reduced to a ninth!
